decisions.reason: It fits the firm's core salami and organic know-how, has remained on the website across two years, and therefore looks learnable and commercially manageable within its existing capabilities.

The product is close to the firm's established salami business, but its reduced prominence on the website in 2024 suggests somewhat weaker momentum, so it is more at risk than the other core-line launches.

An organic boiled sausage builds directly on the firm's traditional meat-processing knowledge and strategic organic expansion, which makes it a natural candidate to retain while the firm continues to build volume.

Thinly sliced organic chicken breast is still within the firm's cold-cut competence and organic direction, though slightly less central than salami and sausage, so the risk of discontinuation is only modestly higher.

Organic herb-coated salami is extremely close to the firm's strongest existing product knowledge base and supports its assortment-broadening strategy, so management would be inclined to keep and refine it rather than withdraw it.
